summary_md: **Andy | Practical AI ([@AndyBuildsAI](https://x.com/AndyBuildsAI/status/2116132488237957578))** covers Google's **Artemis** for natural-language Android automation with caveats: Android only, bring-your-own key, an open shell-injection issue and your screen sent to the model, so use a spare phone ([google/artemis](https://github.com/google/artemis), [issue #55](https://github.com/google/artemis/issues/55), [AndroidWorld](https://github.com/google-research/android_world)).
